source.document: ASAS Real Estate OS — Task Register

phase.name: Platform Provisioning (Autonomous Operator)
phase.objective: Using the operator's full platform permissions, provision and wire GitHub, Supabase, and Vercel from nothing into a guarded platform: protected repository, secured-and-recoverable production database, isolated development environment, and a proven end-to-end delivery pipeline. No application code, no schema changes, no external providers.
phase.entry: The AI developer holds admin on GitHub (repo creation), Supabase (project administration, including the existing production project), and Vercel (project creation + deployment). Founder's email is available for spend alerts; the registrar stays in founder hands.
phase.exit_gate: End-to-end trace green on a trivial PR (branch, CI, preview, review, merge, migration no-op, production deploy); production restore drill passed BEFORE any other production action; secrets matrix seeded in platform stores with zero secrets in the repo; spend alerts received by founder.

tasks.title: GitHub repository: private repo 'asas', AGENTS.md at root, docs/blueprint registers + schema, runbooks, PR/issue templates, CODEOWNERS, branch protection on main (require PR + status checks, no force-push)
tasks.evidence: Bootstrap push log; protection ruleset export; dry-run PR rendering the templates

tasks.title: Secure the EXISTING production Supabase project before anything else: operator access recorded, PITR enabled, full backup, point-in-time restore verified into a scratch project (row-count diff of all 15 tables), scratch deleted after evidence
tasks.contracts: App. T.4, T.8; N1/N2 spirit; Ch. 33
tasks.evidence: Restore drill report: timestamp, 15-table row-count diff, time-to-restore

tasks.title: Development isolation: asas-dev Supabase project (same region), seeded from a schema-only production dump (<=24h old); connection topology mapped: DATABASE_URL (pooled), DIRECT_URL (session), SHADOW_DATABASE_URL (local only); shadowDatabaseUrl wired for migrate dev
tasks.evidence: Dev project URL; prisma migrate status clean against seeded baseline; .env.example committed with names only

tasks.title: Role hardening on both projects: asas_app runtime role (non-owner, NOBYPASSRLS), asas_migrate, asas_readonly; RLS posture confirmed; all passwords straight into the credential store
tasks.evidence: \du output from both projects; app connection strings reference asas_app

tasks.title: Vercel project: import from GitHub, Next.js preset, main as production branch, EU function region, deployment protection on previews, three env scopes created, automatic production deploys DISABLED in favor of the post-migration-release deploy hook; no custom domain until Phase 6 cutover
tasks.evidence: Project settings export; placeholder deploy renders on the assigned URL; deploy hook secret stored

tasks.title: Environment and secrets matrix seeded exactly per App. T.6 (DATABASE_URL per scope, DIRECT_URL as Actions secret, AUTH_SESSION_SECRET, SENTRY_DSN/AUTH_TOKEN, CRON_SECRET, NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL); .env.example names-only; repo secret-pattern scan clean; NO provider credentials (vault-only, later phases) — v1.6.1: the SENTRY_DSN/AUTH_TOKEN rows name their source: the founder creates the Sentry account (free tier, 50k errors/mo) and pastes the two values into the credential store once; every external prerequisite in the matrix carries a named source column
tasks.evidence: vercel env ls + Actions secrets listing match the matrix; clean scan report

tasks.title: CI skeleton ci.yml: lint, typecheck, unit (+coverage floor 80% domain/application), schema-validate + drift report (register count + name-diff assertions), integration (ephemeral postgres:17 service container — platform-matched), e2e stage wiring (on merge, resettable seeded preview), gates, security (gitleaks every PR; SBOM + pnpm audit + lockfile-diff on main), build; all stages required checks; PR concurrency cancel-in-progress, main never; merge demonstrated blocked on red
tasks.evidence: Green run URL on dry-run PR; blocked-merge demonstration

tasks.title: Release pipeline + guardrails: migration workflow on main (prisma migrate deploy via DIRECT_URL, then deploy hook on success, page incident ladder on failure); spend alerts to founder (test alert received); incident runbook committed to docs/runbooks/
tasks.evidence: Workflow log showing hook call after migration stage; founder confirms test alert email

tasks.title: Day-0 exit trace: trivial PR travels branch, CI, protected preview URL, review, squash-merge, migration no-op, deploy hook, production URL, smoke check; exit checklist + evidence packet written to docs/reports/; P-7 gate review with founder
tasks.evidence: docs/reports/t-p.9-exit-trace.md linking every stage's artifact; phase-p-exit.md checklist
